words.definition: Have or hold someone or something within.
words.example: The old wooden box was said to contain a priceless hidden treasure.

words.definition: The quality or state of being correct or precise.
words.example: The archer hit the small target with incredible speed and perfect accuracy.

words.definition: Consisting of two parts, elements, or aspects.
words.example: The new modern airplane features a dual engine system for extra safety.

words.definition: Move from a lower position to a higher one; come or go up.
words.example: We woke up early to watch the beautiful sun rise over the mountains.

words.definition: A condition of body and mind that typically recurs for several hours every night, in which the nervous system is relatively inactive.
words.example: You need at least eight hours of sleep to feel fully rested tomorrow.

words.definition: A warm-blooded egg-laying vertebrate distinguished by the possession of feathers, wings, and a beak.
words.example: A beautiful blue bird flew down from the tree and landed on the fence.

words.definition: A store where medicinal drugs are dispensed and sold.
words.example: She drove to the local pharmacy to pick up her doctor's prescription.

words.definition: The action or process of bringing something into existence.
words.example: The beautiful painting is the latest creation by the famous local artist.

words.definition: Lacking in movement, action, or change, especially in a way viewed as undesirable.
words.example: The company's profits remained static for the third year in a row.

words.definition: The place where an incident in real life or fiction occurs or occurred.
words.example: The police quickly arrived at the scene of the terrible car accident.

words.definition: A person or animal that hunts.
words.example: The skilled hunter tracked the large deer through the snowy forest.

words.definition: A polite or formal term for a woman.
words.example: The kind old lady always baked delicious cookies for the neighborhood children.

words.definition: A clear, transparent mineral or glass resembling ice.
words.example: She wore a beautiful necklace made of sparkling blue crystal.

words.definition: Known about by many people.
words.example: The famous actor signed autographs for his excited fans after the movie premiere.

words.definition: A person who has written a particular text or writes books or articles as an occupation.
words.example: The talented writer just published her third highly successful mystery novel.

words.definition: A person chosen to preside over a meeting or a committee.
words.example: The chairman called the important board meeting to order right at noon.

words.definition: Behavior involving physical force intended to hurt, damage, or kill someone or something.
words.example: The peaceful protesters strongly condemned any acts of violence in the city.

words.definition: Take (a liquid) into the mouth and swallow.
words.example: You should always drink plenty of water after a tough workout.

words.definition: A place of study or training in a special field.
words.example: He enrolled in the prestigious military academy to become a trained pilot.

words.definition: Characterized by constant change, activity, or progress.
words.example: The dynamic new teacher brought a lot of incredible energy to the classroom.

words.definition: Either of the two sexes (male and female), especially when considered with reference to social and cultural differences.
words.example: The new law promotes complete gender equality in the modern workplace.

words.definition: Put (food) into the mouth and chew and swallow it.
words.example: We should eat our delicious dinner before it gets completely cold.

words.definition: Lasting or intended to last or remain unchanged indefinitely.
words.example: The terrible accident caused permanent damage to the car's front engine.

words.definition: The science or practice of farming, including cultivation of the soil for the growing of crops.
words.example: Modern agriculture relies heavily on massive machines and advanced chemical fertilizers.

words.definition: A small valley, usually among trees.
words.example: We found a beautiful, quiet dell in the forest to have our picnic.

words.definition: The action of making something clean, especially the inside of a house.
words.example: She spent the entire Saturday morning cleaning the kitchen and the living room.

words.definition: A range of investments held by a person or organization; or a collection of a person's work.
words.example: The artist showed her impressive portfolio of beautiful paintings to the gallery owner.

words.definition: Of or concerned with the actual doing or use of something rather than with theory and ideas.
words.example: The students gained valuable practical experience by working directly in the laboratory.

words.definition: Restricted or limited to the person, group, or area concerned.
words.example: The expensive restaurant has a highly exclusive guest list for its grand opening.

words.definition: A thing made or used for sitting on.
words.example: Please find a comfortable seat and make yourself at home before the show begins.

words.definition: The property possessed by an object of producing different sensations on the eye as a result of the way it reflects or emits light.
words.example: Her favorite colour is the deep, beautiful blue of the ocean.

words.definition: A person or company offering something for sale.
words.example: The street vendor sold delicious hot dogs and cold drinks to the tourists.

words.definition: From or in the beginning; at first.
words.example: The old house was originally built more than one hundred years ago.

words.definition: The study of the fundamental nature of knowledge, reality, and existence.
words.example: He decided to study Greek philosophy to better understand ancient human thought.

words.definition: A rule or directive made and maintained by an authority.
words.example: The new safety regulation requires all construction workers to wear hard hats.

words.definition: The action or fact of making a specified thing smaller or less in amount, degree, or size.
words.example: The store announced a massive price reduction on all winter coats this week.

words.definition: Point or direct (a weapon or camera) at a target; have the intention of achieving.
words.example: You must aim the camera carefully to capture the perfect photograph.

words.definition: The process of providing or obtaining the food necessary for health and growth.
words.example: Good nutrition is absolutely essential for the healthy development of young children.

words.definition: A piece of music or video that has been recorded.
words.example: The band went into the studio to finish the recording of their new album.

words.definition: For or denoting young or younger people; lower in rank.
words.example: The junior members of the team had to clean up after the long practice.

words.definition: A charge payable for permission to use a particular bridge or road; or the cost in damage or loss.
words.example: We had to stop and pay a small toll before crossing the long bridge.

words.definition: A plural definite article in French, frequently appearing in English loan phrases or names.
words.example: They visited the famous Les Misérables theater production during their trip to London.

words.definition: A sleeveless cloak, typically a short one; or a large piece of land that sticks out into the sea.
words.example: The superhero wore a bright red cape that blew dramatically in the wind.

words.definition: A common female given name.
words.example: My friend Ann is always incredibly kind and generous to everyone she meets.

words.definition: What is meant by a word, text, concept, or action.
words.example: She looked in the dictionary to find the exact meaning of the difficult word.

words.definition: The pointed or rounded end or extremity of something slender or tapering; or a small piece of advice.
words.example: He gave me a very helpful tip on how to fix my broken bicycle.

words.definition: Coming after, less important than, or resulting from someone or something else that is primary.
words.example: The main goal is to win, but a secondary goal is to have fun.

words.definition: Inspiring delight, pleasure, or admiration; extremely good.
words.example: We had a truly wonderful time exploring the beautiful city during our vacation.

words.definition: Used to refer to a thing or things belonging to or associated with the speaker.
words.example: That beautiful blue car parked in the driveway is actually mine.

words.definition: The standard unit of electrical inductance; also a common male name.
words.example: The engineer calculated the exact inductance of the coil in henrys.

words.definition: A piece of paper or small card that gives the holder a certain right, especially to enter a place, travel by public transport, or participate in an event.
words.example: You must show your ticket to the guard before you can enter the stadium.

words.definition: Estimate or suppose (something) without sufficient information to be sure of being correct.
words.example: If you don't know the exact answer, just try to make a good guess.

words.definition: The action of stopping something from happening or arising.
words.example: Crime prevention is the absolute highest priority for the new city police chief.

words.definition: Used instead of 'who' as the object of a verb or preposition.
words.example: The mysterious man, to whom the letter was addressed, never actually arrived.

words.definition: Each of a pair of long narrow pieces of hard flexible material fastened under the feet for gliding over snow.
words.example: She bought a brand new pair of skis for her winter trip to the mountains.

words.definition: Mathematics.
words.example: He has always been incredibly talented at solving difficult math problems in his head.

words.definition: Bring (goods or services) into a country from abroad for sale.
words.example: The country has to import most of its oil because it has no reserves.

words.definition: An appointment to a job, especially one abroad or in the armed forces; or a message published online.
words.example: He recently accepted a difficult new posting at the embassy in Paris.

words.definition: The state or fact of existing, occurring, or being present in a place or thing.
words.example: The strong police presence at the festival made everyone feel much safer.

words.definition: Happening or coming immediately.
words.example: The new movie was an absolute instant success, breaking all box office records.

words.definition: Working by itself with little or no direct human control.
words.example: The glass doors are completely automatic and will open when you walk near them.

words.definition: The greater number.
words.example: The vast majority of the students voted to cancel the difficult final exam.

words.definition: The title, also treated as a name, given to Jesus of Nazareth.
words.example: The beautiful ancient church was built to honor and worship Jesus Christ.

words.definition: A common male given name, often short for Daniel; or a martial arts rank.
words.example: He recently achieved his second dan black belt in the difficult martial art.

words.definition: Further forward in space; in the line of one's forward motion.
words.example: The fast runner was far ahead of everyone else in the long race.

words.definition: The natural satellite of the earth, visible (chiefly at night) by reflected light from the sun.
words.example: The bright, full moon illuminated the dark forest like a giant glowing lamp.

words.definition: The action of taking part in something.
words.example: Active participation in the classroom discussions will greatly improve your final grade.

words.definition: A large-scale systematic plan or arrangement for attaining a particular object or putting a particular idea into effect.
words.example: The cunning criminals developed an elaborate scheme to rob the heavily guarded bank.

words.definition: The state of being useful, profitable, or beneficial.
words.example: The new kitchen gadget is of great utility when preparing large family meals.

words.definition: Move through the air using wings.
words.example: We watched the beautiful eagle fly gracefully over the tall, snow-capped mountains.

words.definition: A way in which a thing is done or happens.
words.example: She handled the very stressful situation in a highly professional and calm manner.

words.definition: An environment or material in which something develops; a surrounding medium or structure.
words.example: The complex rock matrix contained several beautiful, sparkling ancient crystal deposits.

words.definition: A joining or merging of different parts or qualities in which the component elements are individually distinct.
words.example: The delicious soup is a perfect combination of spicy peppers and sweet tomatoes.

words.definition: A minor change or addition designed to improve a text, piece of legislation, etc.
words.example: The politician proposed a new amendment to the country's oldest legal document.

words.definition: Without being affected by; in spite of.
words.example: They decided to go for a long walk despite the heavy, freezing rain.

words.definition: The quality or state of being physically strong.
words.example: He used all of his incredible strength to lift the heavy wooden box.

words.definition: A large bird native to North America; or a country bridging Europe and Asia.
words.example: We cooked a massive, delicious turkey for our traditional family holiday dinner.

words.definition: Truly what something is said or regarded to be; genuine.
words.example: You must use the proper tools if you want to fix the engine correctly.

words.definition: A triangular tract of sediment deposited at the mouth of a river.
words.example: The incredibly fertile soil in the river delta is absolutely perfect for farming.

words.definition: An unpleasant emotion caused by the belief that someone or something is dangerous, likely to cause pain, or a threat.
words.example: She tried hard to overcome her deep fear of flying in small airplanes.

words.definition: In classical mythology, a unique bird that lived for five or six centuries in the Arabian desert, after this time burning itself on a funeral pyre and rising from the ashes with renewed youth.
words.example: The mythological phoenix is a powerful symbol of rebirth and endless eternal life.

words.definition: A way in which something is usually done, especially within a particular area or activity; or a large meeting.
words.example: Thousands of excited fans attended the huge comic book convention in the city.

words.definition: First in order of importance; main.
words.example: The principal reason for the meeting is to quickly discuss the new budget.

words.definition: A girl or woman in relation to her parents.
words.example: His youngest daughter is currently studying medicine at a very famous university.

words.definition: Position, status, or reputation.
words.example: The famous scientist has an excellent standing in the global medical community.

words.definition: A state of physical ease and freedom from pain or constraint.
words.example: The luxurious hotel provides absolute comfort and incredible service to all its guests.

words.definition: A type of whitefish found in cold-water lakes; or a common name.
words.example: They caught a large cisco while ice fishing on the frozen lake yesterday.

words.definition: Present participle of order; give an authoritative direction or instruction to do something.
words.example: We are ordering several delicious pizzas for the big family party tonight.

words.definition: Past tense of keep; have or retain possession of.
words.example: He carefully kept all of his important documents in a locked metal safe.

words.definition: The first letter of the Greek alphabet; denoting the dominant animal or person in a group.
words.example: The aggressive alpha wolf bravely led the pack through the dark, snowy forest.

words.definition: Make a serious or urgent request, typically to the public.
words.example: The police made a desperate public appeal for any information about the crime.

words.definition: A voyage on a ship or boat taken for pleasure or as a vacation.
words.example: They booked a romantic luxury cruise around the beautiful sunny Caribbean islands.

words.definition: An amount of money added to wages on a seasonal basis, especially as a reward for good performance.
words.example: She received a massive holiday bonus for her incredible hard work this year.

words.definition: The action or process of providing someone or something with an official document attesting to a status or level of achievement.
words.example: You must earn your medical certification before you can officially practice medicine.

words.definition: At a previous or earlier time; before.
words.example: She previously worked as a talented graphic designer before starting her own business.

words.definition: Used to attract attention, to express surprise, interest, or annoyance, or to elicit agreement.
words.example: Hey, could you please pass me that heavy red book on the table?

words.definition: A strip of leather, cardboard, or other material used to mark one's place in a book.
words.example: She used a beautiful silk bookmark to easily save her spot in the novel.

words.definition: Strike (a person or an animal) repeatedly and violently so as to hurt or injure them, typically with an implement.
words.example: The talented drummer began to rhythmically beat the loud drums on the stage.

words.definition: A house and its occupants regarded as a unit.
words.example: The busy mother manages the entire chaotic household while working a full-time job.

words.definition: A kind of clay used as a building material, typically in the form of sun-dried bricks.
words.example: The beautiful historic church in the desert was built completely out of adobe.
